basis: HD-ZIP IV (ATML1/HDG2 clade) L1-identity TF; tunica-restricted by Molecular Cartography in the vSAM section (Fig 3a) and top vSAM tunica DE gene (Supp Table 10 Tun-KN1neg 0.92 vs 0.05; integrated "G2 phase" cluster, which is primordium epidermis, 0.98 vs 0.17) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Spike MC in the same study agrees (not independent).
HD-ZIP IV (PDF2-like) L1 TF; tunica-restricted by Molecular Cartography in vSAM (Fig 3a); Supp Table 10 Tun-KN1neg 0.68 vs 0.02 (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Single study.

HD-ZIP IV (HDG11-like); tunica-restricted by Molecular Cartography in vSAM (Fig 3a); integrated tunica cluster 0.26 vs 0.06, Supp Table 10 0.36 vs 0.01 (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Low detection.

PDR-type ABC transporter (cuticle-export family); tunica-restricted by Molecular Cartography in vSAM (Fig 3a), but weakly specific in scRNA (integrated tunica 0.29 vs 0.11; Supp Table 10 0.26 vs 0.08) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
PROTODERMAL FACTOR1-like (Arabidopsis PDF1 is L1-specific); vSAM tunica DE only (Supp Table 7 cl4 0.69 vs 0.21; Supp Table 10 0.69 vs 0.04); no in situ (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

PROTODERMAL FACTOR1-like; DE in vSAM "Primordia tunica" cl8 (0.50 vs 0.09) and tunica (Supp Table 10 0.33 vs 0.02); no in situ. Conflict: also a spike Xylem subcluster marker (Supp Table 13) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

GPI-anchored lipid transfer protein (Mercator: cuticular lipid export, LTPG); top vSAM tunica DE (Supp Table 10 Tun-KN1neg 0.94 vs 0.09; Supp Table 7 cl4 0.90 vs 0.28); scRNA only (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

LONELY GUY cytokinin-activating enzyme; in situ in L1 of IM and TMM (Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS) and Molecular Cartography in L1 of spike meristem tips (Fig 3e); in vSAM it is the top integrated tunica gene (lfc 5.0, 0.33 vs 0.02) but no vSAM image (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Raised one level for two independent studies; both in situ are inflorescence-stage. ID link to Zhong via Demesa Supp Table 4.

HD-ZIP IV (HDG1/OCL2-like); Molecular Cartography in vSAM meristem tip and leaf founder cells, off in primordia (Fig 3f); low scRNA detection (integrated corpus 0.18 vs 0.04) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Meristem-enriched in laser-microdissected barley meristems (Thiel et al. 2021 Sci Adv; tissue-level, not counted).

Class I KNOX (KN1/STM ortholog; protein identical to UniProt Q43484 KNOX3/Hooded) for meristem maintenance; Molecular Cartography in vSAM corpus, depleted in L1, leaf founder cells and primordia (Fig 3a) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants); in situ in non-L1 IM/TMM (Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS). Also high in subapical stem ("vasculature" cluster lfc 2.5, 0.92 vs 0.35): read with L1 and CRC absent.

LOFSEP MADS; vSAM integrated corpus DE (lfc 4.4, 0.49 vs 0.04) and in the MC panel, no vSAM image. Conflict: broad in spike MC (53.5% of cells) and DE in spike green rachis (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
Argonaute; vSAM integrated corpus DE (lfc 4.6, 0.61 vs 0.06) and KN1+ tunica subset (Supp Table 10 0.59 vs 0.03); uncharacterized in barley (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

WUSCHEL ortholog (best rice hit OsWUS/TAB1, 47% identity); not in the vSAM MC panel and detected in about 1% of vSAM cells (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Rice OsWUS acts in the axillary premeristem zone, not in SAM maintenance (Tanaka et al. 2015 Plant Cell), so OC identity in barley is unproven.

YABBY DROOPING LEAF/CRABS CLAW ortholog (88.5% identical to rice DL Q76EJ0; DL specifies the leaf midrib); Molecular Cartography in vSAM leaf founder cells and primordia where KN1 is off (Fig 3a,f); integrated leaf primordia lfc 5.6 (0.975 vs 0.09) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Single barley study.
YABBY of the TOB1/OsYABBY5 clade (77% identical to rice YAB5); integrated leaf primordia DE (0.60 vs 0.17); no vSAM image (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

MANY-NODED DWARF1 GNAT acetyltransferase (plastochron); DE in vSAM "vasculature"/stem cluster (lfc 2.8, 0.82 vs 0.28) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Conflict: in situ shows patches in the inner SAM and proximal leaf primordia, not vasculature (Walla et al. 2021 PLoS Genet; same V1 ID HORVU7Hr1G113480). Possibly rib-zone/subapical.

PIN1-type auxin efflux carrier (grass PIN1 marks provascular strands and incipient primordia); DE in vSAM "vasculature" cluster (lfc 3.9, 0.85 vs 0.22) and Supp Table 7 cl7 (0.87 vs 0.26); in the MC panel, no vSAM image (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

PXY/TDR receptor kinase ortholog (procambium in Arabidopsis); paper lists it as a cambium marker (Supp Table 4) but it is detected in under 3% of vSAM cells and no in situ (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Ortholog function only.
Class III HD-ZIP (ATHB8/ATHB15 clade; procambium/xylem precursors); paper lists it as xylem (Supp Table 4); not detected in vSAM scRNA (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Ortholog function only.

WOX4 ortholog (69% identical to rice WOX4; procambium in Arabidopsis); in the spike MC panel but not detected, absent from the vSAM fold-change table (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Ortholog function only.

VND NAC ortholog (xylem vessel differentiation); DE in the spike Xylem subcluster (Supp Table 13) but detected in about 2% of vSAM cells (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Protoxylem only in older primordia and stem.
ALTERED PHLOEM DEVELOPMENT MYB ortholog (phloem identity); DE in the spike Phloem subcluster (Supp Table 13) but not detected in vSAM scRNA (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

GOLDEN2-LIKE TF (chloroplast development in photosynthetic cells); DE in vSAM "vasculature" cluster together with LHCB/PSI genes (0.47 vs 0.10; Supp Table 7 cl0 0.43 vs 0.09), i.e. green leaf tissue around the apex (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Also bundle sheath in grasses.
Replication-dependent histone H4; vSAM S-phase cl6 (Supp Table 7, 0.94 vs 0.21) and spike S clusters (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Encodes the same protein as 6HG0550690.
Replication-dependent histone H4; vSAM S-phase cl6 (Supp Table 7, 0.84 vs 0.12) and spike S clusters (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
Replication-dependent histone H3; vSAM S-phase cl6 (Supp Table 7, 0.66 vs 0.08) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
B-type CDK (G2/M); vSAM M-phase cl10 (Supp Table 7, 0.68 vs 0.19) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Not enriched in the integrated "M phase" or "G2 phase" clusters, which are mislabelled.
A-type cyclin (G2); vSAM M-phase cl10 (Supp Table 7, 0.82 vs 0.11) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
A3-type cyclin; in the MC panel (patchy; 15.4% of spike MC cells); vSAM integrated leaf primordia 0.13 vs 0.05 (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
TANGLED1 (division-plane/preprophase band protein); vSAM M-phase cl10 (Supp Table 7, 0.35 vs 0.03) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
